description:
Build unsigned Tezos operations ready for signing. Returns the forged (unsigned) operation bytes and fee details. After preparing, sign locally and broadcast via broadcast_signed_transaction.

Actions:
• native-coins: Build an unsigned native XTZ transfer
• fa1-2-tokens: Build an unsigned FA1.2 token transfer
• fa2-tokens: Build an unsigned FA2 token transfer

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• fa1-2-tokens: 104
• fa2-tokens: 104
• native-coins: 78

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

amount.description: Amount to send, in mutez for native-coins, or in the token's base units for fa1-2-tokens/fa2-tokens (required for all actions)

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

contractAddress.description: FA1.2/FA2 token contract address (KT1...) - required for fa1-2-tokens, fa2-tokens

feePriority.description: Fee priority tier - defaults to standard if omitted

fromAddress.description: Sender's Tezos address (required for all actions)

fromPublicKey.description: Sender's public key - required only when the source account is unrevealed

toAddress.description: Recipient's Tezos address (required for all actions)

tokenId.description: FA2 token ID - required for fa2-tokens

name: prepare_transactions__prepare_transactions_tezos
